summary: Completed backend and frontend regression for fixed-assets catalog updates and membership import preview flow. Backend scenarios for preview/commit/cancel, legacy import compatibility, disposal_date, and organization isolation passed. Frontend main flow passed, but organization switch on login did not switch to general-union in UI automation.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking general-union organization card does not switch selected organization; selected label remains social-solidarity.

integration_issues.issue: UI automation could not proceed with union-org flow because organization selection stayed on social-solidarity before submit.

action_items: Fix login organization card interaction/state update for general-union selection.
After fixing selector/state issue, re-run union UI isolation scenario to confirm membership route remains blocked from UI path as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py remains a large monolith (>5000 lines), increasing regression risk; split fixed-assets and membership import handlers into dedicated modules.
The new fixed-assets and membership preview endpoints correctly keep Mongo _id excluded in tested responses.
Electronic invoice tax-authority external submission remains MOCKED and was out of this test scope.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Used social-solidarity admin_takaful/Admin@123 (fallback admin/Admin@123) and attempted general-union admin_union/Admin@123.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_IT27_* fixed-assets/membership data via API tests; cleanup fixture removes DB artifacts for backend suite. UI used preview-cancel flow (no commit) with /app/tests/iter27_ui_membership.csv.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is reusable and currently green (5/5). Frontend membership/fixed-assets core flow passed. Union login selector issue blocked full union UI isolation verification; backend isolation APIs still passed.
rca of the issue: RCA: Login organization selection appears sticky to social-solidarity despite clicking general-union card. Reproduced in 3 selector attempts (normal click, force click, DOM click) with selected label unchanged. Likely frontend state/event binding mismatch in organization card click handling or persisted localStorage value overriding state update immediately after click.
